snippet.title: SPIDERS (2018) - 80's Monster TERROR
snippet.description:
Get Spiders and all of my other games for $5+ on patreon http://patreon.com/puppetcombo/overview

Something is coming... your town is not safe... Your HOME is not 
safe... your family is not safe... from SPIDERS!

Barricade your home and fight hordes of DEADLY spiders in this 90's inspired FPS

Executive Producers:
Michael Silgero
Drew Lindsay
Fatale Maison

Music:
MXXM - https://soundcloud.com/moonman-productions
& Nick Bassett

Voiceovers: 
Chris Butera
Ginose
